title: Unique rotations of field-valued points
statement: For the same H, h, n, regularity, nonzerodivisor, and maximal-ideal hypotheses, let C = AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H)^n - Polynomial.C h). For every field Ω and ring homomorphisms a b : C →+* Ω agreeing after restriction along algebraMap H C, if a (algebraMap H C h) ≠ 0, there exists a unique ζ : rootsOfUnity n H such that a.comp (rootRotation H h n ζ).toRingHom = b.

proof.text: Let t be the adjoined root and q the common restriction of a and b to H. The defining relation gives t^n=h. The nonzero h-image implies a(t) is nonzero, and agreement on H gives b(t)^n=a(t)^n. Therefore b(t)/a(t) is an nth root of unity in Ω.

Apply strict_local_roots_of_unity to obtain cardinality n for rootsOfUnity n H and that every nonidentity root differs from 1 by a unit. The map restrictRootsOfUnity q n has trivial kernel: an element mapped to 1 would send this unit difference to zero in the field Ω. Thus the map is injective. Mathlib card_rootsOfUnity bounds the cardinality of rootsOfUnity n Ω by n; Function.Injective.bijective_of_nat_card_le now makes the map surjective. Lift the ratio b(t)/a(t) to a root ζ in H.

The definition of rootRotation sends t to ζt and fixes every constant. AdjoinRoot.ringHom_ext reduces a composed with this rotation equals b to the common restriction on H and q(ζ)a(t)=b(t), which follows by multiplying the ratio by a(t). Any other rotation giving b has the same q-image after cancellation of nonzero a(t); injectivity of the root-group map gives equality with ζ. These checks also cover n=1 without a separate case.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0EYG and 09EV, root-of-unity comparison in the standard root cover
proof_origin.note: Lean proof of the existing ratio argument, using the proved strict-local roots-of-unity input and Mathlib finite cardinality bounds. No root-algebra regularity is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem strict_local_root_torsor_unique
    (H : Type u) [CommRing H] [IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing H]
    [IsRegularLocalRing H] (h : H)
    [IsRegularLocalRing (H ⧸ Ideal.span {h})]
    (hh : IsSMulRegular H h) (hhm : h ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal H)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n ∧ IsUnit (n : H)) :
    let C := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ n - Polynomial.C h)
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] (a b : C →+* Ω),
      a.comp (algebraMap H C) = b.comp (algebraMap H C) →
      a (algebraMap H C h) ≠ 0 →
      ∃! ζ : rootsOfUnity n H,
        a.comp (rootRotation H h n ζ).toRingHom = b
